Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick technical check before demo?

Hi Sofia,

Thanks — we just self-signed up and completed the quick product tour. Before we jump into a full demo, our infra team asked for a brief technical intake (15 minutes) to confirm network, VPC options, and embedding latency expectations. Can someone on your side do a short screen to cover:

- VPC / Private deployment options (basic topology)
- Data residency and retention defaults
- Embedding latency and batching behavior for mid-size payloads

We can make time next week; available windows for our lead (Tom) are:
- Tue 7/20: 10:30–12:00 PT
- Wed 7/21: 09:00–11:00 PT

I attached our high-level network topology to give context (network-topology.pdf).

If possible, please include a short agenda and who will join from Redwood — that helps us bring the right person.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Infrastructure
BrightCart

Attachment: network-topology.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)

Hi Maria — great to meet you, and welcome to Redwood.

Thanks for sending the topology. We can absolutely run a 15-minute intake to walk the BrightCart infra lead through VPC/private deployment options, retention defaults, and expected embedding latency at the sizes you mentioned. Proposed plan:

- 5 min: intros + context (you + BrightCart infra lead)
- 8 min: focused Q&A on VPC/KMS/latency
- 2 min: next steps for a fuller architecture walkthrough

Ben (cc'd) will drop a calendar invite once you confirm a slot; I can join for the first half and hand over to Dev for the technical details. Quick availability from our side:
- Tue 7/20: 11:00 PT
- Wed 7/21: 10:30 PT
- Wed 7/21: 15:00 PT

If none of those work, here's a direct 15-min scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min — feel free to pick a time.

Also: is there any specific compliance doc you'd like us to have on hand? If so, send it over and I'll loop in Dev.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
S: +1 (415) 555-0123
